profile.headline: SDET / Data Analyst
profile.summary:
Senior Software QA Engineer with 4+ years of experience in automation testing, software development, and delivering high-quality solutions. Specialized
in test automation as an SDET using JavaScript, .NET, and Java, developing frameworks
from scratch and implementing TDD and BDD methodologies with Playwright,SpecFlow and TestNG.
Proficient in utilizing tools like Selenium, Appium, and Docker to streamline processes and
reduce execution times by up to 75%. Skilled in managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure
DevOps and TeamCity, ensuring efficient software deployment. Experienced in database
testing with SQL and NoSQL and API testing using Postman. Adept at working in Agile
environments, enhancing system reliability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to
meet project goals. Bilingual in English and Spanish, with a strong foundation in
mathematics and engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description: Design and implement an automated testing strategy for ETL processes using .NET 8 and ReqNRoll, ensuring data integrity across complex financial pipelines. Architected a scalable Generic Testing Framework based on a 3-layer architecture (Core, Business, and Test layers) to promote code reusability and maintainability across multiple projects. Led the migration of testing solutions to AWS Step Functions to improve workflow orchestration and significantly optimize execution times for data pipelines. Execute Contract Testing and API validation to ensure microservices communication and system reliability within an asynchronous, event-driven architecture. Validate high-throughput streaming systems by ensuring message accuracy and delivery through Kafka and SQS integrations. Develop integration tests leveraging AWS services, including DynamoDB for NoSQL data validation and AWS CodeBuild for CI/CD pipeline optimization. Conduct Performance and Load Testing using JMeter to ensure system scalability and stability under high-volume transactional loads. Manage CI/CD workflows via GitHub, integrating Secret Management best practices to ensure secure handling of sensitive credentials across environments. Perform advanced SQL querying to validate data transformations and consistency between source and target systems.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained end-to-end automated tests for the Performance Reviews system using .NET and TeamCity, while leveraging LoadRunner to conduct load testing and ensure system performance under high traffic conditions. Monitored system errors, collaborated with cross-functional teams to analyze issues, and provided solutions to improve software quality. Designed, implemented, and maintained automated testing frameworks for an Educational Platform using .NET, SpecFlow, Azure DevOps, and SQL, optimizing test execution and reporting. Led the migration of SpecFlow tests to the Playwright framework, enhancing automation efficiency and test coverage.

positions.description: Skills: SpecFlow · Azure DevOps Services · .NET Core · QA Automation · Docker · .NET Framework · Test Planning · Selenium Testing · SQL

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for developing and maintaining end-to-end automated tests of Tax Forms using C#, Selenium and Docker, reducing 75% time of execution. Migration of automation scripts from Typescript and Jasmine to C#, implementing BDD with Specflow and creating its job in jenkins. Automated Tax Desktop Application using Appium, WinAppDriver, Selenium, C# and Specflow. Working in a collaborative team-oriented environment, sharing information, value diverse ideas, partner with cross-functional and remote teams using agile methodology.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked under the guidance of a senior PHP developer to design and code new features or enhancements for existing web applications using mySql, Laravel, PHP and MAMP. Obtained hands-on experience of working with different open-source technologies, agile and scrum methodology, and understanding the entire SDLC in a corporate environment. Attended daily stand-up meetings and collaborating with other interns to prioritize product features as well as working under deadlines to deliver optimum product to the clients.

positions.title: Market Research Consultant
positions.description:
Presented the reports of complex analysis in easily understandable Excel and PowerPoint documents, allowing clients to quickly engage with the findings.
Implemented new automation procedures to develop surveys and reports efficiently , reducing time by 30%
Utilized SPSS to track and analyze data.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Improved the existing reporting dashboards and presented these to management in order to follow  the sales by department.
Successfully interpreted data in order to draw conclusions for managerial action and strategy.
